---
title: "Clinton Canoe Regatta: Looking at Normality in Distributions"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

clinton <- read.csv("phoebechar/canoeing/clinton/data_repo_submission/full_clinton.csv")

clinton <- clinton |> filter(time != 0)

ggplot(clinton, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 600)

clinton_pro <- clinton |> mutate(pro = if_else(grepl("pro", classID), 1, 0)) |>
  filter(pro == 1)

clinton_canoe <- clinton |> mutate(pro = if_else(grepl("pro", classID), 1, 0)) |>
  filter(pro == 0) |> mutate(canoe = if_else(grepl("oc", classID), 1, 0)) |> filter(canoe == 1)

ggplot(clinton_pro, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 600) +
  xlim(25000, 55000) +
  ylim(0, 130)

ggplot(clinton_canoe, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 600)+
  xlim(25000, 55000) +
  ylim(0, 130)
```

Observe skew and compare. Comment on mode/mean. Compare times relatively. z-scores.
